negative_controls: A catalogued court source is not an ingested judgments corpus.
Absence of a case from this bundle does not establish that no relevant case exists.
Public access does not confer permission for every form of computational analysis.
question.question: Which source families should a researcher inspect for legislation, amendments and judicial treatment of an equality duty, and which parts has Whole-Law actually ingested?

source_records.accessibility_and_language: Public, accessible service; judgment language primarily English; sensitive information handled under publishing policy.
source_records.corpus_boundary: England-and-Wales courts/tribunals received for publication plus UKSC and Privy Council; excludes Scottish and Northern Irish courts/tribunals.
source_records.fair_use_rate_limit_robots: Reasonable requests; obey robots and no external indexing; programmatic bulk searching/enrichment is computational analysis requiring permission.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not all decisions are written or sent; lower-court coverage is selective; appeal status may not be linked; no Scotland/NI corpus.
source_records.legal_force_or_role: Official free publication of judgments/decisions; precedential force depends on court, issue, date and later treatment.
source_records.licence_and_reuse: Open Justice Licence for ordinary reuse; computational analysis requires an additional licence.
source_records.official_enumeration_or_denominator: Official courts-and-coverage pages provide per-court date ranges and, increasingly, counts/completeness descriptions.
ontology_or_schema: source judgment metadata; vendor-specific API representation
source_records.owning_institution: The National Archives with MoJ, HMCTS and Judicial Office
source_records.recommended_ingestion_method: Harvest metadata and permitted text only under the applicable licence; maintain per-court coverage ledger and live-source verification.

source_records.versioning_and_update_model: Courts transfer new judgments; corrections and anonymisation changes can occur; per-court coverage is evolving.
